# Claritia

> Claritia is the inbound automation platform for B2B teams. It captures the visitors, forms and sources that reach you, keeps one clean database of contacts and companies, enriches and scores every account, runs AI follow-up you approve, and routes leads to meetings in your CRM.

## How it works

- Capture: a small script names the companies behind your traffic and stitches people across sessions. Forms, CRM rows and warehouse rows land in the same database. The company match needs no personal data.
- One marketing database: contacts, companies, leads, consent and behavior in one place, with live segments built from AND/OR rules over fields, behavior, scores and consent.
- Sources: import from 60+ tools, sync HubSpot, Salesforce or Omniscient both ways, and query 7 warehouses read-only.
- Nurture: AI writes each email from your own content only, a person approves it, and every consent, unsubscribe, frequency and quiet-hour rule is checked as it sends.
- Sending: from your own verified domain through Amazon SES, with DKIM, SPF and DMARC.
- Lead scoring and routing: fit plus engagement makes the score that names an MQL, then routes the lead to the owner with an SLA and hands off to the CRM.
- Journeys (in build): agent steps pick the branch you named and write the email, with Approvals first.
- Pages (in build): AI landing pages and forms built from your content, shaped per segment.
- Reports (in build): pipeline and revenue traced from AI answers and search, through visits and journeys, to deals won.

## The suite

- Found by Arrowsterr (SEO, GEO and AI search). Converted by Claritia. Closed with Omniscient (CRM, opportunities and deal rooms).
